title: Bosun PKM Typed Relations Contract v1
description: Validates a `$pkm.relations` block inside note YAML frontmatter — not an entire markdown file. Canonical nesting matches existing yeoman/commonplace fixtures: `$pkm: { relations: { <verb>: <urn> | [<urn>, ...] } }`. This object form uses typed predicate verbs with canonical URN targets `urn:<realm>:<entity_type>:<uuid>` (UUID portion `[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}`). It is distinct from the older array-of-`{target,type}` edges used by `$yeoman:interaction/v1` and `canonical-note-contract-v0.1.json`. Unknown verbs are rejected. Each verb specializes `https://bosunpkm.com/schemas/v1/meta/coercion.schema.json#/$defs/urnOrUrnArray` with a realm-specific pattern: a single matching URN string or a non-empty unique array of matching URNs. JSON Schema cannot coerce; acceptors MUST wrap a scalar as a one-element array, and emitters MUST write arrays. Patterns stay local because Draft 2020-12 `$ref` cannot parameterize per-verb URN patterns.
